note: The session's web search allowance was already used up, so nobody could be searched for. Candidates were looked for only on pages that could be reached directly: Wikipedia, the courts', the House's and the caucuses' own pages, party endorsement pages already on file, and guessed campaign addresses. A blank here means not found that way, not that nothing exists. The Department of Education's board pages refused this script (403) and were not used. The Oakland County Republican slate page, which the endorsements file says names Tyler Soncrainte, could not be read as text here, so that endorsement is not recorded in this file. Not reached: the 3rd Circuit Court's judges page (drawn by script), Allegan County's district court page, and the school districts' and Saginaw's board pages.
verifier_note: Every address in this file was re-opened on 2026-10-02 and every finding was confirmed on its page (31 findings). Wording corrected on four campaign-website entries: the address Mike McFall's site settles on, and three descriptions that claimed more than was re-checked or than the page says.
